methods.title: Methods
methods.lede: How XSIC estimates sell impact using XRPL order books and AMM pools.
methods.lede_long: XSIC estimates sell impact by simulating fills against XRPL order books (CLOB) and AMM pools, then choosing the best venue for the requested trade size.
methods.what_body: XSIC estimates how selling an IOU token into XRP may impact price and liquidity on XRPL.
methods.data_item_clob: CLOB (order book offers) via XRPL JSON-RPC.
methods.data_item_amm: AMM pool info via XRPL JSON-RPC.
methods.inputs_item_1: CLOB order books via XRPL book_offers.
methods.inputs_item_2: AMM pool reserves and trading fee via XRPL amm_info.
methods.inputs_item_3: Optional fiat rates (XRP → fiat) from CoinGecko.
methods.flow_item_1: Validate token (currency + issuer) and requested sell amount.
methods.flow_item_2: Fetch order book offers up to the limit you select.
methods.flow_item_3: Simulate fills against the book, computing average price and slippage.
methods.flow_item_4: Fetch AMM reserves and estimate the AMM swap output for the same amount.
methods.flow_item_5: Pick the venue that yields the higher receive amount (CLOB or AMM).
methods.limits_item_1: Order book depth is capped by the Orderbook limit; large trades can be under-estimated if liquidity exists deeper than the limit.
methods.limits_item_2: AMM estimates assume current pool reserves and do not include future swaps or governance actions.
methods.limits_item_3: Fiat values are informational and depend on the external rate feed availability.
methods.results_item_1: Sellability indicates whether the requested amount can fill.
methods.results_item_2: Slippage estimates how much the average price worsens as size grows.
methods.results_item_3: Max sell under X% shows the largest size that stays below a chosen impact threshold.
methods.notes_item_1: XRP is the settlement asset. Enter an IOU token (currency + issuer).
methods.notes_item_2: Results are estimates. Network conditions and on-ledger changes can differ.
methods.notes_item_3: Limits and pagination may cap how much depth we can read per request.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.lede: Quick answers to common questions about XSIC.
faq.q1_title: Why can’t I enter XRP alone?
faq.q1_body: XRPL XRP is the quote asset for most order books. XSIC estimates sell impact for IOUs against XRP, so it requires both a currency code and issuer. For XRP/XRP there is no order book to simulate.
faq.q2_body: XSIC calls public XRPL endpoints in real time and records the fetch time shown in the results. If live data is unavailable, cached values may be shown with a warning.
faq.q3_title: Why is my max sell lower than I expected?
faq.q3_body: The max sell values are based on available order book depth or AMM reserves within the chosen impact threshold. Thin books or high slippage limits reduce the estimate.
faq.q4_title: Why do CLOB and AMM results differ?
faq.q4_body: CLOB results are based on visible offers, while AMM results depend on pool reserves and fees. XSIC compares both and uses the better outcome for your requested amount.
faq.q5_body: No. Fiat amounts are optional and sourced from external feeds. If the feed is down, XSIC will still show XRP values and note that fiat is unavailable.

faq_short.title: FAQ
faq_short.q1_title: Why can't I set currency = XRP?
faq_short.q1_body: XRP is the settlement asset. This tool estimates selling an IOU token into XRP, so you must provide an IOU (currency + issuer).
faq_short.q2_body: No. This is an informational tool and provides estimates only.
faq_short.q3_title: Why can results differ from a DEX?
faq_short.q3_body: Ledger state changes constantly. Offers and AMM liquidity can change between reads and execution.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.lede: XSIC provides informational estimates only. It is not investment, legal, or tax advice.
disclaimer.advice_body: XSIC is a research tool that estimates potential sell impact. You are responsible for your own trading decisions and should verify data independently.
disclaimer.limits_item_1: Estimates depend on public XRPL data that can change rapidly.
disclaimer.limits_item_2: Results are limited by order book depth and AMM reserve snapshots.
disclaimer.limits_item_3: Fiat conversions are optional and may be delayed or unavailable.
disclaimer.warranty_body: XSIC is provided as is without warranties of any kind. BadJoke-Lab and XSIC maintainers are not liable for losses or damages arising from the use of this tool.
disclaimer.body_1: This tool is provided for informational purposes only and does not constitute financial or investment advice.
disclaimer.body_2: All outputs are estimates based on public ledger data at the time of request. Accuracy is not guaranteed.
